notes.title: "Remembering Emily" has completed development and is ready for release!
notes.notes:
After a lot of effort and hard work by a very small team (illustrator, programmer/writer, and the English translator of the title), we can proudly say that the game has been completed.



We are now getting everything ready for the release, fixing tiny bugs in the game (the illustrator keeps wanting to change things 😆) and preparing our promotional efforts.



As passionate fans of Visual Novels, releasing our first title is a huge milestone, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed developing it.



Here are some images we've already revealed on the game's page.
